text:
incident-bot: :warning: INCIDENT 1969876543 - ArgentumBank (VPC / dedicated) experiencing redaction failures during spike. Severity: S2. Notifying on-call. Automated diagnostics started.

Aisha R: taking lead. 5xx and redaction-fail alerts showing up on the dedicated pool for argentumbank-prod. Some requests are queued to buffer with "redaction_error": "parse_mismatch".

Tom H: oncall here. Aisha, what's the buffer size and are entries encrypted?

Aisha R: buffer currently contains ~1.1k entries for tenant argentum-01 across 4 nodes. All buffered blobs are encrypted with customer-wrapped KMS keys, AES-256 at rest, only accessible via our KMS-unseal role. TTL is 72h by default.

Nina S: CS check: customer reporting UI delays and webhook backoffs. They are concerned about potential PII exposure. I've opened support case and notified Argentum security lead (sec-ops@argentum.bank).

Carlos M: quick root cause hypothesis: recent redaction-service 4.0.0 changed nested-object handling for address lines without backward-compatible fallback. Their tenant uses legacy schema with freeform address blocks. Parser throws when unexpected arrays appear.

Aisha R: snippet from our error log: 
```
{"time":"2026-03-15T18:03:12Z","tenant":"argentum-01","level":"error","service":"redactor","err":"parse_mismatch","ctx":"payload[customer.address]: expected object got array","sample_masked":"{\"ssn\":\"***REDACTED***\",\"customer\":{...}}"}
```
Note: sample_masked still contains masked tokens, but raw buffer holds original payload.

LegalBot: Legal note: any retention override that allows human-readable access to buffered logs requires customer consent + written waiver and must be scoped (people, time, purpose). We also need to record a Chain-of-Custody (CoC) entry.

Tom H: proposal: request scoped retention override for argentum-01 for 90 minutes to allow triage + reprocess. Limit access to [aisha, tom, carlos]. Create ephemeral role with KMS-unseal, audit-to legal and security, and disable exports.

support-bot: Support case created: #INC-8421. Customer contact: patrick.j@argentum.bank. Notified via secure channel.

Nina S: Patrick asked for details of who will access logs and what we will do. He's asking whether we can re-run reprocessor with masking-only mode first.

Carlos M: we can run reprocessor with --mask-on-replay to ensure reprocessed output never contains unmasked PII. We'll run it in a private namespace. if that passes we can auto-commit processed records.

Aisha R: while we await written waiver, can we snapshot a small random sample (200 entries) and attempt a dry-run with mask-on-replay? This avoids touching the full buffer until approved.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: redaction-service 4.0.1 patch build queued to infra-canary in 15m.

Tom H: hold any canary until we coordinate with customer. If 4.0.1 fixes the parser we still need waiver to access buffered raw blobs.

Patrick J (via support): "Argentum legal needs a short statement: who, why, retention period, and confirmation that no raw exports will be taken out of your environment. We can approve if scoped."

Nina S: sending legal template now. Attached waiver template includes fields for signer, permitted personnel, retention window, and audit recipients.

Aisha R: running sample snapshot command: 
```
sysctl snapshot --tenant argentum-01 --limit 200 --dest ephemeral://debug-argentum-20260315 --sanitize=off
```
then will replay with: 
```
reprocessor replay --source ephemeral://debug-argentum-20260315 --mode mask-on-replay --schema-check strict
```

Carlos M: sample run started. Will examine for parse failures and ensure output tokens are masked.

ops-bot: Audit: snapshot created by aisha_r for tenant argentum-01. Snapshot ID: snap-ARG-20260315-1. Access restricted.

Carlos M: sample replay finished: 200/200 processed, 0 parse errors on strict mode after applying temporary tolerance flag that coerces single-element arrays into objects. Output shows masks in place.

LegalBot: Received signed waiver via secure channel from Argentum legal (WAIVER-ARG-20260315-01). Permitted personnel: aisha_r, tom_h, carlos_m. Retention override duration: 90m. Conditions: no raw exports, audit copies to legal+security, immediate deletion after completion.

Tom H: applying retention override now with command: 
```
redwood-admin retention override --tenant argentum-01 --duration 90m --allowed-users aisha_r,tom_h,carlos_m --audit-to legal@redwood.com,security@redwood.com --no-export
```

ops-bot: Audit: retention override applied by tom_h for tenant argentum-01 until 2026-03-15T19:33:00Z. WAIVER: WAIVER-ARG-20260315-01. Temporary role binding created.

Aisha R: unsealing KMS with ephemeral key access and starting full reprocess with mask-on-replay and strict schema patches. Command: 
```
kms unseal --key-id customer/argentum/kek --role-temp tom_h --ttl 90m
reprocessor replay --source buffer://argentum-01 --mode mask-on-replay --schema-patches fix-array-coerce
```

Carlos M: full replay progress: 1.1k entries -> reprocess rate ~300/s. Will stream metrics to incident channel.

incident-bot: Metrics: reprocess_rate=280/s, errors=3 (all fixed by coercion rule), remaining=0 (ETA 00:00:00).

Aisha R: reprocess completed. All buffered entries reprocessed and wrote to processed stream. No unredacted payloads were exported.

ops-bot: Audit: buffer deletion requested by aisha_r. Deleting buffer objects and recording CoC.

ops-bot: Audit: buffer deletion complete. Deletion records uploaded to legal S3: s3://redwood-legal/waivers/WAIVER-ARG-20260315-01/deletion-log.json (access: legal+security).

LegalBot: Confirmed audit bundle received and verified. Please attach waiver and CoC to customer file.

Nina S: Notifying customer: "Per your waiver, we've reprocessed the queued logs with masking safeguards, fixed parsing edge-case, and deleted the raw buffer. No raw exports were performed. Please let us know if you'd like a joint review"

Patrick J (via support): "Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please share RCA and any prevention steps you will take."

Tom H: follow-ups: (1) RCA write-up, include schema-compat checks at ingress; (2) add automated waiver workflow link in incident runbook; (3) backfill unit tests for array/object coercion; (4) add per-tenant buffer-size alerts and faster retention scaling.

Carlos M: I'll open a JIRA for the parser fix and tests: INFRA-2309.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1969876543 status -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to S3. Channel will auto-archive in 72h.

Aisha R: handing to post-incident owner Tom H for RCA. Thanks team. :clap:

Tom H: taking post-incident. I'll schedule RCA and include Legal and CS notes. Closing thread.
